baseline_comparisons.notes: Current custom systematic MDS array-code reference. Not a standards Reed-Solomon implementation.

code_parameters.error_erasure_bound: documented error-only radius t=floor(parity_len/2); known-erasure API not documented

hazards: Field polynomial and generator/root parameters require source audit before parameter matching.
Raw encode/decode requires exact parity_len, data_len and original_len agreement.
Documentation describes a silent same-n/same-FCR parity-parameter mismatch family.
The 17-byte CRC-checked framed header is not FEC-corrected.
baseline_comparisons.notes: Pure-Rust no-unsafe decoder documented as syndromes, inversionless Berlekamp-Massey, Chien and Forney, with post-correction syndrome verification. Documentation describes RS(255,223) as the default CCSDS profile; that does not make a custom parameter set a CCSDS code.

code_parameters.minimum_distance: must be reconciled with crate documentation and executable behavior
code_parameters.error_erasure_bound: documented as 2*errors + erasures < num_roots; verify edge condition against code theory and executable tests

hazards: Decoder docs describe min_distance as num_roots and correction up to min_distance/2, but state decode_with_erasures succeeds only when 2*errors + erasures < num_roots; edge semantics require executable confirmation.
The docs warn that beyond-radius patterns can be miscorrected and report success; independent payload digest is mandatory.
The codeword is defined as 255 symbols; short-message shortening and emitted length must be proven before treating it as RS(6,4).
baseline_comparisons.notes: Exposes primitive polynomial, first consecutive root, generator root gap and num_roots as constructor parameters. Its CCSDS constructor is a separate documented profile.

code_parameters.error_erasure_bound: whole-block erasure recovery only; unknown symbol errors are not corrected

baseline_comparisons.notes: Only the erasure-throughput lane. Pin a release/commit and verify matrix and symbol ordering before use.

code_parameters.error_erasure_bound: whole-shard erasure reconstruction; caller must detect corruption and mark bad shards as missing

baseline_comparisons.notes: Separate erasure-only comparison. Do not present throughput as an unknown-error correction result.

global_rules: Crate versions are candidate version pins, not a completed Cargo.lock/source-checksum lock.
No external implementation is accepted as parameter-matched until field polynomial, basis, roots, shortening, symbol order and parity placement are independently reproduced.
All decoders return candidate data only; out-of-band expected payload digests remain independent acceptance authority.
Report short-code, equal-rate long-code and erasure-only performance comparisons separately.
